notes: Pepes is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 PEPES once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no administrative powers, transfer fees, public mint or burn functions, or upgrade mechanism. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the requested paired token and a 0.3% fee with tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), treating Pepes as currency0 and the paired token as currency1. The deployer derives the opening price from economics and totalSupply using the actual currency ordering.
